summary: Code review and UI testing completed for 4 bug fixes: 1) CRM Map uses uncontrolled state (initialViewState.current, no onMove), 2) Portal Map uses uncontrolled state (initialViewState.current, no onMove), 3) DealMarker has no CSS transitions/blur/drop-shadow - clean SVGs with cursor:pointer only, 4) Portal Map markers have no CSS transitions - clean SVGs, 5) handleEditContact opens ContactFormPanel with editingContactForPanel, 6) handleDelete uses fetch DELETE with auth token, 7) handleMarkerClick updates selectedDeal with full API response. All 3 files compile without errors.

crm_map_uncontrolled_state.details: Map uses initialViewState.current (useRef) passed to Map component. No onMove handler found - map state is uncontrolled for performance.

portal_map_uncontrolled_state.details: Map uses initialViewState.current (useRef). No onMove handler. Uses mapRef.flyTo() for programmatic centering (lines 95-99).

crm_dealmarker_no_transitions.details: DealMarker component uses clean SVGs with only cursor:pointer and position:relative. No CSS transitions, blur, or drop-shadow filters.

portal_markers_no_transitions.details: Portal markers use clean SVGs with only cursor:pointer. No CSS transitions, transform, or drop-shadow filters.

handle_edit_contact_opens_panel.details: handleEditContact calls setEditingContactForPanel(contact) and setShowContactFormPanel(true) - opens ContactFormPanel with pre-filled data.

handle_delete_uses_fetch_api.details: handleDelete uses fetch DELETE to ${API}/deals/${data.id} with Bearer token auth (not Supabase client).

handle_marker_click_updates_selected_dea.details: handleMarkerClick fetches full deal from API and updates selectedDeal with setSelectedDeal({ ...fullDeal, isTeamDeal }).

frontend_compiles.details: All 3 files compile without errors - frontend logs show 'Compiled successfully!'

portal_map_ui_test.details: Portal map loads with 8 markers, clicking marker opens side panel with deal details (title, address, price, LOT, Zoning, View Full Details button, Save button).

critical_code_review_comments: MapView.js: Uses uncontrolled map state (initialViewState.current) - no onMove handler that would cause React re-renders on every frame
PortalMap.js: Uses uncontrolled map state (initialViewState.current) - uses mapRef.flyTo() for programmatic moves instead of controlled viewState
DealMarker (MapView.js lines 254-278): Clean SVG markers with only cursor:pointer - no transitions, blur, or drop-shadow that would cause GPU performance issues
Portal markers (PortalMap.js lines 151-167): Clean SVG markers with only cursor:pointer - no CSS transitions or filters
handleEditContact (PropertyIntelligencePanel.js line 654-657): Correctly opens ContactFormPanel with editingContactForPanel state
handleDelete (PropertyIntelligencePanel.js lines 457-494): Uses fetch DELETE with auth token - not direct Supabase client
handleMarkerClick (MapView.js lines 609-637): Fetches full deal from API and updates selectedDeal with complete data
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 bug fixes verified through code review: 1) Both CRM and Portal maps use uncontrolled state (initialViewState.current, no onMove) for performance, 2) All markers use clean SVGs without CSS transitions/blur/drop-shadow, 3) Contact edit opens ContactFormPanel with pre-filled data, 4) handleMarkerClick updates selectedDeal with full API response. Portal map UI tested - markers clickable, panel opens with deal data. CRM map requires Supabase auth for E2E testing.
